final: WITH g AS (SELECT b.link_to_event AS ev, e.status AS status, AVG(b.amount - b.spent) AS ga FROM budget b JOIN event e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY b.link_to_event, e.status), s AS (SELECT status, AVG(ga) AS sa FROM g GROUP BY status), j AS (SELECT g.ev, g.status, g.ga, s.sa, g.ga / s.sa AS ratio FROM g JOIN s ON g.status = s.status), o AS (SELECT AVG(ga) AS oa FROM j WHERE oa IS NULL OR 1=1) SELECT AVG(j.ga) AS avg_group, AVG(j.ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(j.ga - o.oa) AS avg_diff FROM j JOIN o ON o.oa IS NOT NULL WHERE j.ga > o.oa
